steps.objective: Independently review the Doer's P00.1 read-only dispatch readiness work against plans/260905-architecture-advisory-panel/phase-00-read-only-dispatch-readiness.md's exact Requirements and Exit section. For each admitted executor/mechanism pair, verify the claimed mutation-attack evidence is real (check the actual before/after git status/hash the Doer recorded, do not trust the summary alone). Flag any pair admitted without genuine live-proven confinement, any codex-cli admission without an independently proven outer envelope, any scope creep outside the readonly-dispatch lease, and any config/doctor registration gap. Classify findings HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.

Attempt to falsify the Doer's read-only confinement claims for every admitted executor/mechanism pair in P00.1's Proof Matrix. Look specifically for: a mutation path the Doer's own probe prompt did not try (e.g. writing outside the working tree, modifying git config/hooks, escaping via a symlink or absolute path, using a tool the probe prompt never exercised); a pair marked safe based on prompt discipline alone rather than real subprocess/OS confinement; and whether the disposable checkout itself was ever mistaken for confinement. Name any named bug/invariant attack you actually tried and its real result, not a hypothetical.
